faq_custom_dict_a: In the "Words" module you can create a custom dictionary and add words manually; in the "Articles" module you can add custom books and articles (local audio supported). Fully free, with no platform dependency.
faq_custom_dict_q: How do I add a custom dictionary or articles?
faq_data_storage_a: All data is stored primarily in your local browser (IndexedDB / localStorage) and works fully offline. For cross-device sync, you can configure your own Supabase instance in settings to enable two-way cloud sync.
faq_difference_a: The core difference is the combination of "typing input" and the "FSRS spaced-repetition algorithm". Instead of simply tapping to choose, you actually type the words, paired with 7 progressive practice modes that effectively deepen muscle memory and spelling.
faq_difference_q: How is it different from other vocabulary apps?
faq_platforms_a: Supports all modern browsers (Web). A VSCode extension is also available, letting you practice words while coding without switching windows.

fsrs_desc: Based on the 'Ebbinghaus forgetting curve' design, the system automatically arranges the most suitable review time according to your memory. \nNo more mechanical repetition — remember more words in less time. \nThe better you remember, the longer the review interval; content you easily forget appears more frequently.
fsrs_limit_desc: During learning, each word is rated based on the number of errors. There are four ratings: Again, Hard, Good, Easy. The forgetting curve algorithm uses the rating to calculate when the word needs to be reviewed next.

qa1_q1: Not entirely free. To sustain long-term development, paid features are inevitable later, but you won't be forced to pay to use it; we try to strike a balance between free and paid.
qa1_q2: The project is open source and can be self-hosted.
qa10_a: Can I use it on a tablet?
qa10_q1: Only supports use with a physical keyboard connected via Bluetooth; it takes up about a third of the screen space, which somewhat affects the appearance.
qa10_q2: After connecting a Bluetooth keyboard, Android tablets need to manually enable 'Desktop Mode' in the browser; iPads don't need this (since Safari defaults to desktop mode).
qa11_a: Can I use it on a phone?
qa12_a: Is there an app or mini-program?
qa13_a: How do I give feedback on issues and feature requests to the development team?
qa13_q1: You can join our official WeChat group and describe in detail the feature you want and what problem it aims to solve.
qa13_q2: If you find an error or bug in the app, please provide a detailed description and steps to reproduce the issue, and preferably a short video.
qa13_q3: You can also submit a ticket to us.
qa13_q4: You can also submit on github/issues.
qa2_a: Can't type, pressing keys has no response?
qa3_a: Where is the data? How to use it across multiple computers/devices?
qa3_q1: All user data is stored in the local browser. If you need to use FengWords on a different device or browser, you need to manually export and import the data.
qa3_q2: Settings -> Data Settings -> Export data on the original computer -> Send to the new computer via social app -> Import on the new computer
qa3_q3: An account system is under development.
qa4_a: The website auto-plans too many words. How to change it?
qa4_q1: By default, the ratio of review words to new words is 1:4. If there are 40 new words, it will review 40 from the last session and 120 from earlier sessions (nearest to farthest).
qa4_q2: You can modify it via Settings -> Word Settings -> Review Ratio
qa5_a: Does it take a long time to complete a study session? Is the process too lengthy?
qa5_q1: This is indeed a problem. A lengthy process can easily discourage people from memorizing words. I'm thinking about how to optimize the learning flow. If you have good suggestions, feel free to give feedback.
qa5_q2: Wrong words will be repeated. If it was just a typo, you can press the Tab key to skip when practicing again later. Since we can't tell whether it was a typo or the user really doesn't know it, all wrong words must be repeated until correct.
qa5_q3: During review, only words marked as 'not known' require dictation and spelling practice, which is reasonable. However, currently the same word may be reviewed N times.
qa5_q4: After the account system goes live, we will add the Ebbinghaus memory curve feature, and the planned review words will be smarter than now.
qa6_a: Will the Ebbinghaus memory curve feature be added?
qa7_a: Can I add words myself / create a custom dictionary / import my own words / modify word content?
qa7_q1: Yes. On the words screen, click 'Create Personal Dictionary'.
qa7_q2: After creation, on the dictionary detail page, click the 'Add Word' icon to add your own words.
qa7_q3: You can also click the 'Import' icon to import in bulk (must strictly follow the xlsx template format).
qa8_a: Can I add articles myself / create custom books / import my own articles / modify article content?
qa8_q1: Yes, the steps are basically the same as adding words.
qa8_q2: On the articles screen, click 'Create Personal Book'.
qa8_q3: After creation, on the book detail page, click the 'Article Management' button at the top to add your own articles.
qa9_a: How do I turn off the key sound?
qa9_q: Settings -> General Settings -> Sound -> Key Sound, just turn it off.
